data.name: Private ASA Request
data.headline: $500 deposit due for request. The deposit is applied toward the total, once course is scheduled.
data.description:
Learn to sail on your schedule with private ASA 101, 103, 104, 103/104 combo, and 114 courses. Get personalized instruction, flexible dates, and focused time on the water so you can build real confidence at your own pace.

ASA 101 - Basic Keelboat
For beginners looking to master fundamentals like sail trim, points of sail, and docking.
*$1,212 - up to 3 students (including ASA certification and log book)*
*$1,616 - up to 4 students (including ASA certification and log book)*

ASA 103 - Coastal Cruising
Move up to larger boats while learning coastal navigation, cruising skills, and boat handling.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 104 - Bareboat Cruising
Become charter-ready with training in boat systems, trip planning, anchoring, and passagemaking.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 103/104 Combination
An efficient way to earn both certifications in one streamlined, private course.
*$3,750 - up to 3 students*
*$5,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 114 - Cruising Catamaran
Learn to handle cruising catamarans with confidence through hands-on, private coaching.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,400 - up to 4 students*

Book a private course today and start your sailing journey with skills that stick.

data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 7 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
Please note all classes may be rescheduled by Seaforth if the minimum number of students is not met, due to inclement weather, or at the discretion of Seaforth Boat Rentals. In the event of forecast inclement weather, we will do our best to notify students at least 24 hours prior to cancellations.

You may cancel or reschedule your class registration more than seven days prior to your class start date. If you fail to cancel more than seven days prior to your class or fail to attend your class, your registration fees will be forfeited and you may only re-register at full price. Classes are nonrefundable within seven days of class start date.
data.booking_notes:
You will be contacted by the Seaforth Sailing Club Director to confirm your dates with an instructor.

##Next Steps:

Please head to the ASA Sign-up website below to create an ASA Log In, if you don't already have one. Be sure to bring your confirmation email on day one of the course. 
https://members.asa.com/asid/register.php

##Below are some details about your potential course:

Please plan to arrive 10 minutes before to check in with your instructor.

##Enrollment terms and conditions/What to Expect:

In order to attend and pass the ASA 101 class, you are REQUIRED to read ""Sailing Made Easy"" by ASA prior to arrival. This is not optional and is mandatory.

The review questions at the end of selected chapters will cover everything you need to know for the written test on the second day of class. We also recommend an ASA log-book, to track your sailing hours and ASA certifications. Both are available at our locations for purchase. You can also purchase your course book online from ASA, both physical copies and e-book versions are available. Please visit the ASA website HERE if you would like to purchase your materials from ASA.

##What to Bring: 
We recommend that you bring a hat, sunscreen, sunglasses, light jacket, snacks/lunch, water, and you must wear close toed rubber soled shoes.(White soles) The class will break for lunch for 30 minutes, so bringing a bag lunch is recommended. Our Harbor Island location sells pre-made sandwiches, snacks, as well as has a restaurant on site for purchase, but is based on availability. 

##PARKING: 
Safe Harbor Marina offers paid parking for $30 per day, but during check in we offer a $15 parking voucher. There are other parking lots near by based on availability.  *prices subject to change and are not affiliated with Seaforth Boat Rental*

Please remember that if you need to cancel or reschedule your course for any reason, you can call 619-223-1681 up to 7 days prior to private course. If you have any other questions, feel free to get in touch.

See you soon!
Jessica McManus
Seaforth Sailing Club Director

Q: How does the $500 deposit work?

A: We take a $500 deposit at the time you submit a private course request. This deposit is fully refundable and will be applied toward the total cost of your course once the dates are scheduled.
